newsitem.title: USA: Saratoga Beverage enters distribution pact.
newsitem.headline: Saratoga Beverage enters distribution pact.

text.p: Mineral water company Saratoga Beverage Group Inc said Tuesday it reached an agreement with Hype Beverage Corp that gives it exclusive rights to distribute Hype products in the United States.
Saratoga said the agreement marks the end of discussions on any further transactions with Hype; in February the two companies said they had begun talks about a possible "business combination."

The "master distribution agreement" gives Saratoga the exclusive right and license to distribute Hype products in the United States until June 30, 2000, while granting Hype, a maker of vitamin-enhanced energy drinks, the right to sell Saratoga-branded products outside the United States.
Under the agreement, Saratoga will received $1.00 per case of Hype beverages sold in the U.S. plus an additional $1.00 per case for the first 50,000 cases sold.
For its part, Hype will be paid a 5 percent commission based on the net invoice for sales of Saratoga-branded products, Saratoga said in a statement.
